name: qa-automation-demo
description: A small event sign-up app plus a layered Playwright + TypeScript test suite.

scripts.app: npm run build -w platform-ui && npm start -w platform-ui
scripts.app:fresh: npm run reset-data && npm run app
scripts.reset-data: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('platform-ui/data/app.db',{force:true}); console.log('Dev data cleared: the app will reload the seed data (21 of 25) on its next start.')"
